links.outcome: Macro-AUROC on external cohort without retraining versus internal test fold
links.effect: Macro-AUROC 0.932 on PTB-XL test fold fell to 0.898 on the Chapman-Shaoxing cohort (n = 1599) with no retraining.
links.quote: Applied without retraining to an independent cohort (Chapman-Shaoxing, n = 1599) the model retains a macro-AUROC of 0.898.

links.outcome: AUROC under added noise with signal-quality gate
links.effect: Performance degraded gracefully to SNR 5 dB (AUROC 0.951) as the quality gate rejected uninterpretable signals.
links.quote: Performance degrades gracefully to a signal-to-noise ratio of 5 dB (AUROC 0.951) as the quality gate rejects uninterpretable signals, and rules and network agree only weakly (Cohen's kappa 0.26), indicating complementary errors.

unlisted_practices: Offline on-device inference to preserve data sovereignty
Fusion of deterministic rule-based, neural network, and VLM interpreters
Intrinsic explainability linking findings to signal segments and literature sources

screen.reason: The study develops and empirically evaluates an edge-deployable ECG interpretation pipeline that incorporates specific safeguards/practices including a three-tier signal-quality gate for rejection of noisy signals, deterministic rule-based explainable fusion, and human-in-the-loop escalation.

primary.practice: signal-quality gating, offline local deployment, deterministic rule fusion, and human-in-the-loop escalation
